name: supervisor_breach_dry_run_dispatch_20261107
comment: supervisor_breach_detector raised NO_OUTPUT for every lane the n8n dispatcher only ever runs in a dry mode
(LQ-20261107-297): 182 OPEN rows over 11 days on 17 lanes, one per lane per day, and n8n_self_heal could never
close them because no later run can be live. The lane's declared output_signal is unwritable by design there
(prospectus_window.py returns before write_receipt unless --apply). The exemption is scheduler.kind == 'n8n'
only: investment-costs is cron-scheduled with a stale dispatch.mode dry_run and still runs live, so it must keep
paging. The 18 exempt lanes are named on the run summary (dry_run_dispatch) so 'not breaching' never reads as
'producing'. Hermetic: pure detect() calls plus one main() dry run over a tmp code root and state root.
